target_statement: Certify strict positivity of the completed-zeta localized Weil form at physical half-window a=0.8 (project L_program=3.2), ideally with Chuk's claimed floor 8.9e-18, on the correct logarithmic form domain.
claim_status_sought: RIGOROUS_INTERVAL_COMPUTATION plus an analytic full-domain enclosure; conditional or floating evidence must remain labelled as such.
trust_model: Primary-source formula audit, independent high-precision reproduction, Arb or equivalent outward-rounded interval arithmetic, exact certificate replay, and a theorem-kernel wrapper for the finite algebra where practical.
first_unproved_edge: A full-space coercive lower bound from a finite even/odd Legendre block plus rigorously bounded quadrature, matrix-entry, and infinite-block tail errors.
mask_or_node_class: Exact completed Riemann-zeta Weil source with active prime powers 2, 3, and 4 at log n < 1.6; no smoothing or source replacement.
source_data_retained: Pole evaluation term, archimedean digamma symbol, and each active von-Mangoldt cosine term with exact normalization.
coefficient_cone_and_sign: All complex functions in the localized logarithmic form domain; parity reduction must be proved rather than assumed. The initial numerical matrices may be audited separately in real even and odd sectors.
normalization: Chuk L=project physical half-window a=0.8; autocorrelation support is [-1.6,1.6]; project L_program=4a=3.2; angular Fourier transform F(t)=integral f(u)e^(itu)du.
height_window_and_one_sided_floor: All Fourier heights. Chuk's one-stroke reduction uses T_sharp=200 and beta*=log(T_sharp/(2pi))-1/T_sharp-A_L; the final target floor is at least 8.9e-18 times ||f||_2^2.
quantifier_order: For every f in the stated form domain, one fixed certificate at a=0.8 proves the lower bound. Numerical discretization choices are fixed before f.
resolution_required: Outward-rounded enclosures fine enough that total finite-block plus tail uncertainty is strictly smaller than the certified spectral floor; sampled eigenvalues alone are inadmissible.

rate_and_exponent_ledger.required_error_budget: strictly below the lower spectral margin after all analytic and interval errors

feasibility_or_nonvacuity_witness: Existing independent floating Legendre calculations report an even-sector minimum near 1.68e-17 at 80 modes, next even eigenvalue near 8.44e-12, and odd minimum near 1.59e-14; these are diagnostics only.
downstream_socket: A certified a=0.8 seed improves the local Weil positivity endpoint. It does not propagate positivity, prove global Weil positivity, or prove RH without a separate actual-zeta adjacent-support theorem.
why_not_target_renamed: This is a fixed-window certification problem with finite prime-power support and a claimed explicit spectral gap, strictly weaker than adjacent propagation or global positivity.
fast_falsifiers: Recompute A_L and beta* from the exact normalization.
Reproduce the parity spectra at increasing precision and basis size.
Test whether the published one-stroke symbol inequality has the correct sign and Fourier constants.
Check whether the stated L2 theorem is actually extended-valued outside the logarithmic form domain.
Reject any finite Galerkin positivity without a certified tail Schur bound.
Reject a certificate whose total enclosure radius reaches the 8.9e-18 floor.
decision_tree_change_if_proved: Promote the local seed from a=7/16 to a=0.8, then attack the nearby p=5 activation at L_program=2 log 5. No global theorem status changes.
decision_tree_change_if_refuted: Downgrade only Chuk's numerical theorem or chosen certificate architecture; local positivity at a=0.8 may remain true under another proof.
stop_rule: Do not call the window certified unless the exact source, full domain, finite matrix, and infinite tail are all enclosed with positive residual margin and the certificate is independently replayable.
